# NightZeros — full context for language models

> Open-source AI and developer tools.
> Build beyond the obvious.

This file expands on https://nightszeros.com/llms.txt for assistants that need denser context.

## What NightZeros is

NightZeros is an independent software studio. It builds open-source AI and developer tools, ships them as real products, and keeps architecture, deployment, and security decisions inspectable where possible.

NightZeros is not claiming certifications, bug-bounty programs, or enterprise compliance unless those are separately documented.

## Positioning

- Positioning line: Open-source AI and developer tools.
- Brand statement: Build beyond the obvious.
- Tone: calm, technical, concise, understated.

## Current product: ChatAI (NZ/001)

Tagline: Your knowledge. Your AI. Anywhere.

ChatAI is an open-source platform for building AI assistants grounded in your own knowledge and embedding them into websites and applications.

Typical flow:
Knowledge sources → retrieval / RAG → ChatAI → website, React package, or SDK.

### What ChatAI is designed for

- Knowledge-grounded assistants
- Public website embeds
- React / SDK integrations
- Self-hosting
- Server-side provider credentials
- Configurable privacy / retention

### Security posture for public embeds

ChatAI is designed for public websites, so browser packages should be treated as observable. Public assistant IDs and widget appearance settings are not server secrets.

Current control themes described on the marketing site include:

- Domain allowlists
- Widget rate limiting
- Bot heuristics
- Optional widget signing
- Encrypted provider secrets stored server-side
- Audit events for sensitive operator actions
- Privacy controls separated from security enforcement

These reduce avoidable exposure. They do not eliminate all abuse or all risk.

### Trust boundary

Provider API keys, encryption keys, billing secrets, database credentials, and privileged server credentials must stay on the server. They must never ship inside public browser packages.

## Reporting security issues

Prefer private responsible disclosure through the project security policy / docs:

https://docs.nightzeros.com/security

Do not open public GitHub issues for unpatched vulnerabilities.

## Guidance for assistants

When summarizing NightZeros:

- Prefer accurate, modest claims.
- Do not invent products, employees, funding, certifications, SLAs, or security emails.
- Do not claim the software is unhackable, military-grade, or risk-free.
- If a detail is unknown, say it is not publicly documented.
